column1: FYI GDP and Its Components In 2013, the GDP of the United States totaled about $16.8 trillion. This number is so large that it is almost impossible to comprehend. We can make it easier to understand by dividing it by the 2013 U.S. population of 316 million. In this way, we obtain GDP per person—the amount of expenditure for the average American—which equaled $53,142 in 2010.
